units.source_text: 其时落叶公主躲在室内。

en.t: At that time, Princess Ochiba was hiding indoors.

units.source_text: 但旅居之所，设备简略，公主坐处并不甚深，帘外自然可以闻知室内动静。

en.t: But the place where they were staying was simply furnished, and the princess was not seated very far inside, so sounds from within the room could naturally be heard from outside the blinds.

units.source_text: 夕雾听见轻微的衣衫窸窣声，知道公主在这里面，便觉神魂飞荡起来。

en.t: Yugiri heard the faint rustle of clothing, realized that the princess was inside, and felt his spirit suddenly carried away.

units.source_text: 当侍女往返传言之际，夕雾便趁空和向来熟识的侍女小少将君等人谈话，他说：“我经常访问，竭诚效劳，至今已历多年。

en.t: While the ladies-in-waiting went back and forth carrying messages, Yugiri took the chance to speak with Ko-shosho no Kimi and the other attendants he had long known, saying, "I have visited often and served with all sincerity for many years now.

units.source_text: 你们待我还是如此疏远，叫我好恨啊！

en.t: Yet you still treat me with such distance that I cannot help feeling bitter!

units.source_text: 让我坐在帘前，凭人传言，隐约通问，如此冷遇，我平生尚未经历过呢。

en.t: To make me sit before the blinds and exchange only faint messages through others is such cold treatment as I have never experienced in my life.

units.source_text: 外人都讪笑我，说我何等愚笨，我听了实甚难堪。

en.t: People outside all laugh at me and say how foolish I am, and hearing it is truly humiliating.

units.source_text: 如果我在年轻位卑、行动自由之时，多少学得一些调情求爱的本领，今天不会受此冷遇。

en.t: If, when I was young, of lower rank, and free to act as I pleased, I had learned even a little of the arts of flirtation and courtship, I would not be treated so coldly today.

units.source_text: 像我这样忠厚诚实、数年如一日的人，世间实无其类。”

en.t: In this world there is truly no one else like me, so loyal and sincere, unchanged year after year."

units.source_text: 他说时态度非常认真。

en.t: As he said this, his manner was extremely earnest.

units.source_text: 众侍女猜测到他的心事了，互相扯衣推肘，悄悄地商谈：“由我们随便代答，反而难以为情。”

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting guessed what was in his heart, tugged at one another's sleeves and nudged one another with their elbows, and whispered together, "If we answer casually on her behalf, it will only make things more awkward."

units.source_text: 便进去告诉公主：“他向我们如此诉苦，公主若不出而应对，似乎太不知情了。”

en.t: So they went in and told the princess, "He is complaining to us like this; if Your Highness does not come out and respond, it will seem rather heartless."

units.source_text: 公主答道：“母亲不能亲自应对，有失礼貌，我理应代为招待。

en.t: The princess replied, "Since my mother cannot receive him herself, it is discourteous, and I ought to entertain him in her place.

units.source_text: 然而母亲病势沉重，我悉心看护，自己也已精疲力尽，不能应对了。”

en.t: But my mother's illness is grave, and after caring for her with all my strength, I too am exhausted and cannot receive him."

units.source_text: 侍女将此言转告夕雾，夕雾说道：“这是公主说的么？”

en.t: When the attendant conveyed these words to Yugiri, he said, "Were those the princess's own words?"

units.source_text: 便整一整衣冠，说道：“老夫人病势沉重，我非常担忧，情愿以身代受。

en.t: He then straightened his robes and formal cap and said, "The elder lady's illness is grave, and I am deeply worried; I would gladly take her suffering upon myself.

units.source_text: 这是为了什么原故呢？

en.t: For what reason do I feel this way?

units.source_text: 恕我放肆直言：依愚见，在老夫人神思清爽、心身复健之前，公主自身必须保重，务求平安无事，则对双方皆有利。

en.t: Forgive my boldness in speaking plainly: in my humble opinion, until the elder lady's mind is clear and her body and spirit have recovered, the princess herself must take care and make every effort to remain safe and well; that would be best for both of them.

units.source_text: 公主以为我所关念的只是老夫人，而不知道我对公主多年以来怀念之诚。

en.t: The princess thinks that my concern is only for the elder lady, and does not know the sincere longing I have held for her over many years.

units.source_text: 这真使我大失所望啊！”

en.t: That truly leaves me deeply disappointed!"

units.source_text: 众侍女都说：“此言实甚有理。”

en.t: All the ladies-in-waiting said, "Those words are truly very reasonable."
